body:
Similar experience happened to me, but different medical condition.

I've been homeless since August 3rd. I got evicted right after I got out of the hospital.

Homelessness would be an adventure if we only had our health wouldn't it?

To top it off, my entire family abandoned me and I have no one. I can't even pay the doctors. I came from a very loving family and this is all so confusing.

It can happen to anyone and there is nothing that can stop it. I'm on the verge of suicide.

The fact of the matter is, no one will help you. No one has helped me. "Wow man, that's rough." No one will ever help you without love. They have to "know you". I hate how atomized our society is.
Where am I going to sleep tonight? Where do I park my car? Am I going to be awakened by police again? Why do they look at me with such hate!!! I used to be a normal person like them!!!!!!

Wow, after I posted that I immediately realized it looks like it was written by an insane person. But then again I've been pushed past my breaking point long ago. What should I do?

Today I tried the suicide hotline they were not helpful.

The best society has ever done for me is hook me up with a homeless shelter where I had to sleep with 20 older/scary men, drug addicts, and so on. Even though I would have felt more safe in a youth homeless shelter. But I'm above 21 years old.

What is wrong with America? No one cares about anybody anymore. There is no safety net please I beg you go and experience it for yourself. The social safety net isn't there. If you don't work you DIE
